summary: Two blocking verification defects reproduced with in-memory mutations of retained artifacts. README scope and task ownership remain appropriately bounded; no unjustified test weakening found. No files changed or network used. Full engine suites were not rerun.

findings.finding: XMage effect validation checks only entries present, while semantic comparison drops effects entirely. Using GR-040-RG-S0-heuristic from final-run-1.tar.gz, compare_game still passes after replacing every XMage effects list with [], removing 319 entries across primary and auxiliary observations. An observer that omits active effects therefore receives admission despite the required intermediate-effect contract. Validate expected effect presence and lifecycle, and add an executable deletion regression.

Trigger identities are checked against tape keys but are not bound to actual trigger provenance. On the retained GR-040-RG-S0-heuristic pair, compare_game passes after deleting XMage trigger_provenance and replacing all eight stack trigger raw_source values with the zero UUID and raw_source_zcc with 999. Semantic projection discards these fields, so missing or incorrectly rebound physical-source evidence is admitted. Require provenance and validate each raw source/incarnation against its witnessed binding, with normal-discovery corruption tests.
